conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I’m panicking! My loan account shows a missed payment, but I paid it!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m here to help Sir. Can you confirm your loan account number?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s nine zero, one two, four eight, six five, seven seven. This could mess up my credit score!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I see the payment was delayed due to a processing error. I’ll update the status now.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Thank God! Please make sure it’s fixed.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: It’s corrected Sir. Your account is up to date, and I’ll confirm with CIBIL.
